verdict.rationale: Zapier documents an official SDK, @zapier/zapier-sdk, installed via npm. Its quickstart covers OAuth or client-credential authentication and running actions across 9,000+ apps, and agents can use it as a typed Node module or through a companion SDK CLI. Zapier also ships the Platform CLI for building integrations in Node.js, and publishes OpenAPI specs that support building against its APIs. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond Node/TypeScript, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK's depth and reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install @zapier/zapier-sdk via npm, authenticate with OAuth or client credentials, and execute actions across 9,000+ apps.
run them as an agent skill, a CLI, a typed Node module, or a local MCP server
The Zapier SDK CLI lets you explore and run actions across {appCount} apps directly from your terminal, authenticated, with no OAuth setup required.
Zapier Platform CLI enables developers to build integrations using Node.js v22, OAuth1/OAuth2 authentication, webhooks, polling triggers, and HTTP middleware.
